chapter_title: Matter around us: Pure Substances, Mixtures and Separation Techniques

m1_zero_omission_notes.chapter_executive_summary: Analyzes homogeneous vs heterogeneous mixtures, solutions, concentration formulas, solubility curves, and separation methods like crystallization.

detailed_section_hierarchy.full_explanation: Solutions are homogeneous mixtures (particle size < 1 nm). Colloids scatter light (Tyndall Effect). Separation uses crystallization, distillation, chromatography.

glossary_and_key_terms.definition: Scattering of a light beam by colloidal particles in a fine suspension or colloid.
glossary_and_key_terms.contextual_example_or_usage: Sunlight passing through a dusty canopy.

formulas_rules_and_laws.name: Mass Percentage Concentration
formulas_rules_and_laws.statement_or_expression: Concentration (%) = (Mass of Solute / Mass of Solution) * 100
formulas_rules_and_laws.variable_definitions: Mass of Solution = Mass of Solute + Mass of Solvent

m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.activity_or_procedure_title: Separation of Pure Copper Sulfate by Crystallization
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.objective_or_aim: Obtain pure CuSO4 crystals from an impure sample.
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.expected_observations_or_working: Pure blue geometry crystals form at dish bottom.
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.scientific_or_logical_conclusion: Crystallization yields purer solids than simple evaporation.

scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Why is crystallization preferred over simple evaporation for purifying heat-sensitive salts?

scripted_dialogues.speaker: Student
scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Evaporation can cause solid decomposition or charring, and leaves soluble impurities behind. Crystallization yields pure solid crystals upon slow cooling.
